answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, switching primary vendors (memory_c2) carries delivery risk I cannot validate this cycle, and deferral (memory_c5) leaves the contract expiring in 14 days with no auto-renew, risking interruption. Negotiating terms with the incumbent combines the stability record of memory_c1 with the demonstrated margin recovery from benchmarking in memory_c4 and the volume-pricing leverage of memory_c6, directly targeting the 18% cost mandate without introducing delivery risk. I am verifying memory_c2 and memory_c4 to confirm the claimed cost deltas before using them as benchmarks in the negotiation. If the incumbent cannot approach the 18% target, a dual-source or switch decision should be staged for the next review rather than forced now.
